items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I filled in one night when Trumbauer had the mole taken off under his eye.

ctx.x: Not even just to fool around.

Oh, once in awhile, I'd practice and blow a couple of tunes. I filled in one night when Trumbauer had the mole taken off under his eye. He used to have a mole there and he had it taken off. I played, but it was only one night.

So he wanted me to play and arrange, but the difference of playing with that band, the guys would be great, but the difference of playing with them. He was going -- he got the New Yorker job, the Goldkette band didn't get it and Whiteman didn't want it. So this is what these guys had to look forward to, and he also said he could get them a lot of recordings, that he did a lot of recording himself.
